catalysts.headline: Gary Merrill named CFO, with start date expected around 2026-12-03 (announcement date not independently established this pass)
IonQ shares rose more than 10% early in the session (settling to roughly +2.5% by late morning) tied to promotional coverage of the company at the SC26 Supercomputing Conference
IonQ extended a 5-session losing streak to a cumulative ~25% decline, with the Nov 16 close ($26.45-$26.48) undercutting the stock's prior 52-week low (set 2026-03-30)
CFO Inder Singh stepped down; shares fell ~6.4% that day

IonQ announced an executive leadership evolution: Gary Merrill (currently Commvault Systems CFO) appointed IonQ Chief Financial Officer effective early December 2026 (exact day not yet published); Thomas A. Austin appointed to the newly created Chief Accounting Officer role effective immediately; Inder M. Singh stepped down from his IonQ roles effective immediately
catalysts.impact: Refines/confirms the prior pass's approximate CFO-change item with an official company announcement

catalysts.headline: Stock reported up roughly 12% intraday amid a broader quantum-computing sector rally tied to a reported U.S. government plan to invest about $2 billion in quantum computing; IonQ itself was not named as a direct beneficiary of that plan (D-Wave Quantum and Rigetti Computing were named), but shares rose alongside peers. The same report also references a shareholder vote approving IonQ's pending acquisition of SkyWater Technology, and cites a share price of $58.84.
IONQ shares rose sharply (one source cites +23.42%) the trading day after Q3 earnings
catalysts.impact: Positive market reaction to beat-and-raise quarter

catalysts.headline: IonQ reported record Q3 2026 revenue of $173.8M (+336% YoY), beating ~$141.2M consensus; raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $505-515M (from $450-460M); Remaining Performance Obligations more than doubled to $1.2B
IonQ announced the acquisition of Elisity for $1.15 billion in stock plus an earnout of up to $150 million
catalysts.impact: Expands into adjacent security/networking business; stock-funded deal is a dilution consideration

catalysts.headline: IonQ advanced to the final stage of DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, the only trapped-ion company selected
Q3 2026 results reported (per system state); specific revenue/EPS figures not retrieved this session

Q3 2026 results now confirmed (prior pass's print was still pending): revenue $173.8M (+336% YoY), far above the $67M-$144.46M pre-report consensus estimates on file; GAAP diluted EPS $1.42 driven by a non-cash mark-to-market gain on warrants (net income attributable to IonQ $564.0M); adjusted (non-GAAP) EPS -$0.29; adjusted EBITDA loss $133.6M; raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $505M-$515M (from the on-file $280M-$290M).

IonQ press release confirms Q3 2026 earnings date of November 5, 2026, conference call 4:30pm ET

Morgan sole underwriter

catalysts.headline: IonQ shares rose 9.33% to $34.35 on volume more than 100% above average, rebounding from the prior day's equity-offering-related drop
catalysts.impact: +9.33%; still about 53.5% below the 52-week high of $73.87

catalysts.headline: IonQ priced a $2.0 billion common stock offering
catalysts.impact: Shares fell about 5.2% on the pricing news

catalysts.headline: IonQ disclosed plans to deploy its 256-qubit Superion 256 system at NVIDIA's Accelerated Quantum Research Center (NVAQC), directly connected to NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 infrastructure via NVIDIA NVQLink, with workload management through NVIDIA's open CUDA-Q platform; installation timeline given as 2027, with no performance results yet available for this configuration

IonQ and Synopsys reported a quantum-classical hybrid workflow that cut computer-aided-engineering simulation runtimes by 5.9%-14.6% on digital models (automobile, industrial drill component, fluid impeller, jet-engine assembly), simulated at up to 150 qubits with physical execution validated on IonQ's 36-qubit Forte system; one of nine IonQ papers accepted at IEEE Quantum Week 2026 (Toronto, Sept 13-18)

IonQ-Synopsys hybrid quantum-classical workflow cut engineering-simulation runtimes 5.9%-14.6% (won IEEE Quantum Week 2026 Best Paper); IonQ also raised FY26 revenue guidance to $260M-$270M and launched its Superion 256 platform
catalysts.impact: stock up about 9.5%; gains reportedly tempered into the close by a same-day CEO share-sale disclosure

catalysts.headline: Record Q2 2026 results: revenue $80.1M (+287% YoY), beating estimates ($49.7M-$66.5M range); raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $280M-$290M (excludes SkyWater acquisition contribution); adjusted EBITDA loss $120.3M; GAAP net loss $1.87B (mostly non-cash warrant-liability revaluation)
catalysts.impact: Shares rose on the beat/guidance raise

catalysts.headline: Q2 2026 results: revenue $80.05M (+287% YoY vs $20.69M), above the high end of prior guidance; raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $290M; GAAP net loss of $1.87B driven primarily by a $1.65B non-cash warrant-liability revaluation; free cash flow roughly -$114M
IonQ closed its acquisition of SkyWater Technology (semiconductor foundry), adding chip-manufacturing capability; cash+investments fell from ~$3.0B to a pro forma ~$2.0B as a result
